# Original data

**Do not edit, rename, or delete any file in this folder.**
All fixes to the data are done in code (`code/cleaning/`), so every change can be traced.

| File | Description | Unit of observation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `household_survey.csv` | Household survey with size, income and electricity access | One row per household | Fictional survey, collected March 2026 |
| `district_info.csv` | Background information on each district | One row per district | Fictional national statistics office |

Known issues in these files are described in `documentation/data-cleaning-log.md`.
